prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory task-board module. Export exactly `{ createTaskBoard }`. `createTaskBoard()` returns `add(card)`, `get(id)`, `list(offset, limit)`, `patch(id, changes)`, and `remove(id)`. A card has exactly `{ id, title, priority, tags }`: `id` and trimmed `title` are non-empty strings, `priority` is an integer from 1 through 5, and `tags` is an array of strings. `add` rejects duplicate IDs and returns a detached copy. `get` returns a detached copy or `null`. `list` uses insertion order, requires non-negative integer `offset` and `limit`, and returns detached copies; an empty board or an offset beyond the end returns `[]`. `patch` may change `title`, `priority`, or `tags`, rejects unknown fields and malformed values, preserves ordering, and returns `null` for an unknown ID. `remove` returns whether a card existed. No input or returned value may expose mutable board state.
